originality.rationale: The proof gives complete Pick positivity throughout the two-coordinate logarithmically concave parameter wedge, including an open nonconcave, genuinely coupled region b>a,u≠0. The inspected Luo–Rydhe statement proves complete Pick under operator concavity and gives a 3-coordinate logarithmically concave counterexample; neither covers the two-coordinate nonconcave wedge.
